card.title: Victory Without You
card.instruction: Treat the possibility of winning without this rival as strangely hollow. Keep raising the challenge so the relationship survives the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't concede. Who else am I supposed to beat at chess on Tuesdays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next game I start without my queen. Make me earn it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd still lose. Just take the trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take both my rooks too. I'm not spending Tuesdays alone with something that can't gloat.
